title: SYNTHETIC: Suspicious scheduled task creation
description: SYNTHETIC. Endpoint telemetry reports that a scheduled task named DailyTelemetryCheck was created on workstation WS-HR-019 by user jdoe. The task action points to C:\ProgramData\Telemetry\telemetry.exe. Later process telemetry reports taskeng.exe launching telemetry.exe from that path. The incident bundle does not include the executable's file reputation, a file hash, the full task XML, or a related security alert. This is synthetic test data; no real task was created and no executable was run.

attributes.note: SYNTHETIC test data created for CADE development. Not a real incident.
